protocol: Capture top view, 45-degree view and side view of the same physical serving.
Include a standard 5×5 cm reference card or a measured plate in at least one frame.
Weigh empty plate and plated edible food; record net grams.
Weigh rice, stew, kebab, bread and sides separately before combining when practical.
Link every gold dish instance to a frozen recipe version and ingredient batch weights.
Collect home, restaurant, takeaway, tray and plain-background images.
Include daylight, warm indoor, cool indoor and low-light examples.
Collect different garnish levels, bowls, plates, serving sizes and regional styles.
Do not alter ingredients, colour or geometry; record crop/rotation/brightness changes.
Exclude faces, documents, addresses and identifying reflections unless consent covers them.
Retain consent, deletion capability and a private/public-use flag.
All images from the same restaurant/day/menu item must stay in one dataset split.
Near-duplicate frames belong to the same instance and only one may be used in strict test.
Record the name spoken or entered by the cook/user, then verify against ingredients/recipe.
Record added oil, butter, sauce and dressing separately because visual inference is unreliable.
For difficult mixed dishes, optionally capture ingredient-addition photos or a short cooking clip.
Capture non-food scenes, foreign dishes, empty plates and unknown Iranian foods.
Reject severe blur, extreme colour filters, inaccessible ground truth or uncertain licence.
